# `inbox-message/v1` — inbox/<msgid>.md — agent inbox message

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.InboxMessageMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Transient message filed into an agent's inbox by the director
(via Kanban reassignment) or by the scheduler (GEP-24 fired
dispatch). Body is the prompt addendum the agent CLI sees;
frontmatter records origin + context. Agents are the sole
reader and Elixir is the sole writer.

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `from`

**Optional:** `task_id`, `task_path`, `scheduled_at`, `cron`, `subkind`, `delivered_at`


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `from`, `subkind`, `task_id`, `task_path`, `scheduled_at`, `cron`, `delivered_at`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: inbox-message/v1
from: scheduler
task_path: projects/ops/tasks/nightly-digest.md
scheduled_at: 2026-04-21T03:00:00Z
cron: "every morning"
---

Time to run the nightly digest.
```
